[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended low-impact exercises for someone with knee pain: swimming, cycling, yoga, elliptical, and walking.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cycling is excellent for cardiovascular health while putting minimal stress on the joints.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yoga can help improve flexibility and strength while relieving stress.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The elliptical machine can help increase cardiovascular fitness while putting minimal stress on the knee joint.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Walking can improve cardiovascular health while putting minimal stress on the knee, with emphasis on proper footwear and flat paths.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Important to consult a healthcare professional or physical therapist before starting any exercise program, especially with knee pain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended consulting a medical professional or physical therapist regarding hiking suitability for someone with knee pain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If hiking, advised to wear proper shoes or boots with good support and traction, use hiking poles, and stick to easier, flatter trails.
